name: Agent Stats Sync (per agent + conversation snapshot)

nodes.name: Webhook
nodes.notes: Copy this node's Production URL into the app env var N8N_AGENT_STATS_SYNC_URL. App POSTs { org_id, client_id } with header x-n8n-secret.

parameters.query:
-- ADJUST table/column names to your source agent console schema.
-- Must return one row per (agent, customer) conversation with these aliases:
--   agent_name, customer_contact, campaign_id,
--   is_customer_replied (bool/0-1), customer_last_reply, customer_last_reply_at,
--   is_agent_replied (bool/0-1), agent_last_reply, agent_last_reply_at,
--   is_open (bool/0-1), created_at
SELECT a.agent_name        AS agent_name,
       a.customer_contact  AS customer_contact,
       a.campaign_id       AS campaign_id,
       a.is_customer_replied AS is_customer_replied,
       a.customer_last_reply AS customer_last_reply,
       a.customer_last_reply_at AS customer_last_reply_at,
       a.is_agent_replied  AS is_agent_replied,
       a.agent_last_reply  AS agent_last_reply,
       a.agent_last_reply_at AS agent_last_reply_at,
       a.is_open           AS is_open,
       a.created_at        AS created_at
FROM   agent_conversations a
WHERE  a.org_id = $1
  AND  a.client_id = $2;

nodes.name: Query Agent Stats
nodes.notes: Set Operation = Execute Query. Use $1 = org_id, $2 = client_id as Query Parameters (org_id first, client_id second). Adjust the SQL to your source schema.

nodes.name: POST results to app
nodes.notes: x-n8n-secret MUST equal the app's N8N_WEBHOOK_SECRET. Replace YOUR_APP_URL with the deployed app origin.
